method: Ten automatically selected Latin surface forms per V514 chapter or preface, giving priority to attestations of foundational Vitruvian architectural terms, then frequency and chapter distinctiveness. These are not lemmata or paleographically verified H readings.
warning: Occurrence counts and Latin word forms refer to editorial V514, NOT Codex H. Folio candidates are derived from documented chapter anchors or estimated by interpolation, not confirmed manuscript word attestations.
